items.description: One static lookup-table asset reference row — a puck.table.v1 document's stable name, its file path (relative to BaseDirectory, the convention Source uses), and the SHA-256 hex64 pin of the document's canonical bytes. A rule reads it through $table:<name>:<key>; nothing writes it, and it is not simulation state.

hash.description: The SHA-256 hex64 of the referenced document's canonical bytes.
